spans.s: दूत m. A messenger, an envoy, a negotiator,
दूत m. A messenger, an envoy, a negotiator,
दूत-मुख a. speaking by an ambassador.
दूत-मुख a. speaking by an ambassador.
दूतिका f. 1. A female messenger, a confidante, a go-between; (the final ती of दुती is sometimes shortened, See K.S.iv.16, and Mall. on it), R.xviii.53, xix.18; 2. a gossiping, mischief-making woman.
दूतिका f. 1. A female messenger, a confidante, a go-between; (the final ती of दुती is sometimes shortened, See K.S.iv.16, and Mall. on it), R.xviii.53, xix.18; 2. a gossiping, mischief-making woman.
दूत्य n. 1. Employment of an envoy; 2. an embassy; 3. a message.
